title: A worker checks a path against its touches with in_scope before it calls the path outside them
goal: SP-6jfnx5i3 retrospective: ST-jqzp3hai's worker closed its research question with a gap entry and gave as reason that kb/public/_sources.csv was outside its touches, which were kb/public/**; the gap entry was a valid choice, but the reason was wrong. The worker rules have a worker run bl_base.in_scope (or backlog.py's scope check) on a path before it names the path outside its touches in a gate or report.
